Title: Frozen Balloons — Part 1
Content: Students designed an investigation to study the effects of temperature on water and air. This was their procedure:

:ibox:`1`. Fill `text(two)` balloons with water and `text(two)` balloons with air to a volume of `text(1.0 L)`.

`2`. Measure the circumference and the mass of `text(each balloon)`.

`3`. Place `text(one)` water-filled balloon and `text(one)` air-filled balloon in a freezer set at `text(-20°C)`.

`4`. The `text(next day)`, remove the balloons from the freezer, observe any changes, and repeat the measurements in step `2`.
Table `1` shows the results of the water-filled balloon investigation.

The students made models of water particles in ice and liquid water. The students used the models to help them understand the results of the water-filled balloon investigation. Figure `1` shows the students' models. The dotted lines show attractions between water particles.
